description: Look up the specific gravity of five liquid chemicals on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), calculate the mass in kilograms of each chemical given its known container volume, and compile the results into a shipping manifest text file. The chemicals and their volumes are: Acetone (200 L), Sulfuric Acid (50 L), Toluene (150 L), Ethylene Glycol (100 L), and Carbon Tetrachloride (30 L). Create the file at '/home/ga/Documents/shipping_manifest.txt' following the specified format, including the calculated weight (Weight = Volume * Specific Gravity), the total shipment weight, and identifying the heaviest single item.
